targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.ftlPredict_bestRegret_initial_correction
targets.header:
theorem ftlPredict_bestRegret_initial_correction (initial : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    squaredBestRegret y (ftlPredict initial y) T =
      squaredBestRegret y (meanPredict y) T +
        ((initial - y 0)^2 - ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - y 0)^2)

targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.ftlPredict_bestRegret_refined
targets.header:
theorem ftlPredict_bestRegret_refined (initial : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hi : initial ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    squaredBestRegret y (ftlPredict initial y) T ≤
      (1 : ℝ) + ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (T - 1), 4 / ((t : ℝ) + 2)

definitions.name: comparatorRegret
definitions.text:
noncomputable def comparatorRegret {X : Type*} (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (prediction : ℕ → X) (u : X) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t (prediction t)) - ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t u

definitions.name: NoRegret
empiricalMean
definitions.text:
noncomputable def empiricalMean (y : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, y t) / n

definitions.name: meanPredict
definitions.text:
noncomputable def meanPredict (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if t = 0 then 1/2 else empiricalMean y t

definitions.name: ftlPredict
definitions.text:
noncomputable def ftlPredict (initial : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if t = 0 then initial else empiricalMean y t

definitions.name: squaredBestRegret
definitions.text:
noncomputable def squaredBestRegret (y prediction : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (prediction t - y t)^2) -
    sInf ((fun u : ℝ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - y t)^2) ''

definitionAudit.name: comparatorRegret
definitionAudit.sourceRelation: Literal finite subtraction on matching legal source domain after0/1-based reindexing; generic carrier and lack of feasibility constraints are explicit library extensions.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: All typesX and arbitrary losses/predictions/u are permitted; empty sums give0 atT=0. No feasible-set membership is bundled.

definitionAudit.name: NoRegret
definitionAudit.sourceRelation: Literal supplied Lean definition of eventual upper behavior; NOT literal source ordinary-lim definition. Retain semantic delta without approved repair.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: forall u inV, forall positive epsilon, eventually normalized comparatorRegret<=epsilon. Threshold need not be uniform in u. EmptyV gives vacuity; prediction membership inV, causality, lower control and ordinary limit are not part of definition.
requiredRepresentationEvidence: No equivalence to ordinary-limit source definition is accepted. Separate repair authority would be necessary to replace that source definition; it is unnecessary to publish this explicitly different upper property.

definitionAudit.name: empiricalMean
definitionAudit.sourceRelation: Literal arithmetic mean on positive source prefixes; arbitrary-real carrier and n=0 value extend source domain.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: Sum range n divided by real n; n=0 gives0. No bounds or uniqueness implicit.
requiredRepresentationEvidence: Mean belongs to[0,1] only under appropriate prefix bounds; argmin characterization/uniqueness requires proof, not a hidden premise.

definitionAudit.name: meanPredict
definitionAudit.sourceRelation: Literal half-initial source formula on legal bounded runs, after index shift.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: At0 returns1/2; atpositive t returns mean of exactly indices<t, excluding current observation. Unbounded y may yield infeasible values.
requiredRepresentationEvidence: Feasibility on bounded runs is a proof obligation.

definitionAudit.name: ftlPredict
definitionAudit.sourceRelation: Literal general-initial source algorithm on legal a,y after index shift; out-of-interval values are a library extension.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: At0 returns initial; later predictions ignore initial and average strict past. No pseudo-observation, clipping, fallback choice or recursion is hidden.
requiredRepresentationEvidence: Feasibility for legal a and bounded prefixes; no state-recursion/trajectory theorem is implied by this definition.

definitionAudit.name: squaredBestRegret
definitionAudit.sourceRelation: Literal supplied sInf formula; representing printed minimum requires value-equality/attainment evidence, not mere naming. No chosen minimizer or uniqueness is encoded.
definitionAudit.wholeCarrier: All real y,p and naturalT. Comparator set always[0,1]; image is nonempty and bounded below by0; finite squared-loss polynomial attains a minimum on compact interval. T=0 image{0}, regret0. These mathematical observations are not compiled proof acceptance.
requiredRepresentationEvidence: Audit actual reused proof of minimum/infimum equality, and bounded-positive empirical-mean minimizer characterization where consumed. G001 cancellation itself does not need the latter.
